question: Does the public NTNU deposit behind the 2026 Balica-Ciortan-Trumpy controlled reversal-film study expose separately downloadable, rights-clear machine-readable Ektachrome E100 / Velvia 50 film-MSI and painting-HSI payloads sufficient to open a later pixel-integrity audit?
claim_ceiling: public-source availability audit for a controlled reversal-film and hyperspectral-ground-truth study; not a retained pixel dataset, stock response, scanner calibration, digital-to-film operator, training permission or product claim

primary_sources.expected_title: Colour correction of archival photographs for change detection and digital restoration of paintings
The Use of Analogue Photographic Documentation to Infer the Past Appearance of Paintings

acquisition.rights_boundary: The article is CC BY 4.0, but the NTNU deposit files carry only the Norwegian Copyright Act general-terms marker. Download and inspect internally; do not redistribute or treat deposit-file openness as commercial training permission.

allowed_after_pass: freeze a separate exact pixel-integrity, rights, scene, stock, illuminant, exposure, process and scanner manifest
verify film-MSI to painting-HSI registration and group separation before any operator fit
compare root-polynomial and bounded explicit stock-specific baselines only after the pixel audit passes
forbidden: treat article figures or PDF-embedded images as controlled source pixels
infer missing film, exposure, illuminant, process or scanner labels from appearance
treat open download as redistribution or commercial-training permission
fit an operator from the article, thesis or administrative attachment PDFs
call archival-film colour correction an identified digital-to-film operator
stock calibration, latent-mode discovery, training, product integration or authenticity promotion

branch_rule.source_pass: Open only a separate controlled-pixel integrity and rights audit; operator fitting remains forbidden.
branch_rule.papers_only_or_missing_pixel_payloads: Retain the controlled experimental design and latest root-polynomial baseline as literature evidence, close acquisition before pixel fitting and continue another physical-film algorithm leaf.
branch_rule.rights_failure: Retain factual metadata only, do not retain or use pixel payloads, and continue another ready leaf.
